_comment: The `meta` theme (content sets R3): a world that knows it is a generated game. It presents the guardian as the Gate, which states its own rule; it gives the sword's and the swim's checks a line that knows they are checks (their names stay the AP item names, which are logic); and it offers places for a room. It does NOT present water, so water falls through to each substrate's default pack. No image: the Gate's `look` is a colour and a symbol. ⛔ No line may claim something untrue of the world: a place describes only what every generated room has.

meta:object/gate.name: Gate
meta:object/gate.description: A gate that opens for whoever holds Progressive Sword. It knows its rule and says it.

meta:object/sword.name: Progressive Sword
meta:object/sword.description: An item in the pool. A rule may ask for it.

meta:object/swim.name: Progressive Swim
meta:object/swim.description: An item in the pool. A rule may ask for it.

meta:place/room.name: The Room
meta:place/room.description: A room in a generated world. It has at least one exit.

meta:place/waypoint.name: The Waypoint
meta:place/waypoint.description: One stop on the way through this world. The seed decided where it sits.

meta:place/node.name: The Node
meta:place/node.description: On the map, this room is a node. Its exits are the edges.

meta:place/seeded-room.name: The Seeded Room
meta:place/seeded-room.description: This room was laid out from a seed. The same seed lays it out the same way every time.

meta:place/waiting-room.name: The Waiting Room
meta:place/waiting-room.description: Nothing here moves until you do.

meta:place/region.name: The Region
meta:place/region.description: The rules call this a region. You may call it a room.

meta:place/stopover.name: The Stopover
meta:place/stopover.description: Most rooms are on the way to somewhere else. This one may be too.

meta:place/generated-room.name: The Generated Room
meta:place/generated-room.description: Nobody drew this room. A generator made it from a seed and a set of rules.

meta:place/room-with-exits.name: The Room With Exits
meta:place/room-with-exits.description: Like every room here, this one has exits. Try them.

meta:place/grid-cell.name: Grid Cell
meta:place/grid-cell.description: On the world's grid, this room takes up one cell.

meta:place/known-room.name: The Known Room
meta:place/known-room.description: The logic already knows what it takes to reach this room. You got here, so you had it.

meta:place/spot.name: The Spot
meta:place/spot.description: The seed picked this spot for a room. It had to put one somewhere.
